text: index::Framed<S> is a Source plus an Index with no parser: open(path, format), detect, with_index, unsafe map, then record(n), index(), name_index(). IndexedFasta, IndexedStockholm and IndexedHmm are newtypes over it adding try_get, validate and Indexable; nail wraps Framed the same way. A private build_for(bytes, format) dispatches to build_index::<_, D>, so Framed::open scans as the collections always did; Index::build goes through Reader and the two are unbenchmarked.
